books.title: San Kuo; or, Romance of the Three Kingdoms (Volume I)
books.author: Luo Guanzhong
books.synopsis: As the Han dynasty collapses into civil war, the sworn brothers Liu Bei, Guan Yu, and Zhang Fei rise through battle and betrayal alongside the scheming warlord Cao Cao. This volume covers only the first half of the sprawling saga in C. H. Brewitt-Taylor's English translation, the only English edition on Gutenberg.

books.title: The Pillow-Book of Sei Shōnagon
books.author: Sei Shōnagon
books.synopsis: A Heian-era lady-in-waiting records her sharpest opinions, court gossip, and lists of elegant or irritating things, in one of the earliest and wittiest works of Japanese prose.

books.title: The History of Mary Prince, a West Indian Slave
books.author: Mary Prince
books.synopsis: Prince recounts, in her own words, her sale between owners across Bermuda and Antigua and the routine brutality of enslavement, in the first known narrative of an enslaved woman published in Britain.

books.title: Iola Leroy; Or, Shadows Uplifted
books.author: Frances Ellen Watkins Harper
books.synopsis: A mixed-race woman raised believing herself white is enslaved when her parentage is exposed, and after the Civil War chooses to dedicate her freedom to uplifting the Black community rather than pass into white society.

books.title: The Marrow of Tradition
books.author: Charles W. Chesnutt
books.synopsis: A white supremacist coup and massacre convulse a North Carolina town, entangling a Black doctor and his estranged half-white relations in a novel based on the real 1898 Wilmington massacre.

books.title: The Conjure Woman
books.author: Charles W. Chesnutt
books.synopsis: A formerly enslaved gardener spins seven sly folk tales of conjuring and transformation for his new white employers, each story quietly undercutting the plantation nostalgia it seems to indulge.

books.title: The Autobiography of an Ex-Colored Man
books.author: James Weldon Johnson
books.synopsis: A light-skinned Black man drifts between Black and white worlds in the Jim Crow South, Europe, and New York, and ultimately chooses to pass permanently as white, then wonders if he sold his birthright for a mess of pottage.

books.title: Black No More
books.author: George S. Schuyler
books.synopsis: A scientist invents a machine that turns Black skin white, and the ensuing scramble to buy whiteness upends America's racial order, in a razor-edged satire of race, capitalism, and self-hatred.

books.title: The Nibelungenlied
books.author: Anonymous
books.synopsis: The dragon-slayer Siegfried wins and loses the peerless Kriemhild, and his murder by the Burgundian court ignites her decades-long revenge, ending in the annihilation of an entire people at Attila's court.

books.title: Every Man in His Humor
books.author: Ben Jonson
books.synopsis: A jealous merchant, a would-be poet, a blustering soldier, and a gallery of other obsessives collide across a single London day, in Jonson's city comedy of manias and misunderstandings.

books.title: Bartholomew Fair
books.author: Ben Jonson
books.synopsis: A cross-section of London descends on the riotous Bartholomew Fair — a Puritan zealot, a jealous husband, con men, and a pig-woman — for a day of gluttony, fraud, and public humiliation.

books.title: The Description of a New World, Called the Blazing-World
books.author: Margaret Cavendish
books.synopsis: A woman is swept through the North Pole into a parallel world of talking bear-men and fish-men, becomes its Empress, and commissions philosophers and spirits to explain the nature of the universe to her.

books.title: Zadig; Or, The Book of Fate
books.author: Voltaire
books.synopsis: A wise Babylonian is repeatedly ruined by his own virtue and cleverness — losing wives, eyes, and freedom in turn — until fate reveals its hidden design, in Voltaire's sly philosophical fable.

books.title: The Chronicles of Clovis
books.author: Saki
books.synopsis: The languid schemer Clovis Sangrail talks his way through Edwardian drawing rooms, orchestrating small social catastrophes and absurd revenges with total composure, across this story collection.

books.title: The Unbearable Bassington
books.author: Saki
books.synopsis: A doting mother schemes to marry off her charming, feckless son Comus before his debts and indiscretions catch up with him, in Saki's one true novel, which turns from comedy to real loss.
